name: Seekify
description: Self-hosted music server. Scans local libraries, streams audio, and pulls metadata/cover art from MusicBrainz. Download from YouTube (yt-dlp) and Soulseek (aioslsk), generate waveforms, and auto-tag your library. Single Go binary + vanilla JS SPA; mobile-friendly.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: SQLite database, cover/waveform cache, download jobs.

paths.name: Music Library
paths.description: Primary music directory (read/write - autosort and downloads land here).

variables.name: MUSIC_DIR
variables.description: Path inside the container for the primary library.

variables.name: MEDIA_MUSIC_DIR
variables.description: Set to /media-music only if you mount the Secondary Library path.
